title: The weapon loadout: the phone moves the weapon first, the worker's echo corrects it
oneLine: Three weapon slots, the weapon bag and the hand, predicted on the phone and settled by the worker's echo.
topConcern: The Hero page's loadout picker unequips at 8 weapons with no cap check; the worker refuses silently, so the weapon vanishes from the phone.

title: Body armour, shield and the worn layers: a worn slot the worker owns over a bag only the phone keeps
oneLine: Chest, legs and shield worn slots, their phone-only bags, and the renderer's derived and cosmetic chest/legs layers.
topConcern: An equip dropped on a dead socket is repaired at rejoin by name+tierMult only, turning a Rare torso into a second Normal one.

title: Selling from the item card: price sheet, one listing in flight, and the local splice on ok
oneLine: One auction-house listing asked from the open item card, guarded by an in-flight ref, spliced locally on ok.
topConcern: No fetch timeout (TRAPS §77); the guard resets on target change so a late answer clears another card's guard; lost answers leave ghost gear.

title: The item card's life: open on a target, flow, placement, close
oneLine: The one item card's open/target/flow/position and its drop sheet, driven by itemDetailBus.
topConcern: The open card never re-reads the bag, so a stack's count and the sell/drop maximum are the values from the tap.

title: Shopkeeper Bro's window bus: open, selection, quote, busy, settled, rejoined
oneLine: The shop window's open state, picked item, quote, pending ask (busy), settle and rejoin counters.
topConcern: setStock clears busy and shop_state is broadcast after anyone's sale, re-enabling Buy/Sell mid-ask so a double tap trades twice.

title: Who a bag tap belongs to: the shop, a live trade, the Gear tab, or the item card
oneLine: The bag tile's tap mode, decided by which windows are open, and the trade's attach/detach hold on the bag.
topConcern: Item and weapon tiles route in different orders: with the shop open, a weapon tap opens a card whose Sell lists it at auction.

title: Pins (the anchor): in-memory locks that order the bag
oneLine: Pinned bag entries and their pin times, ordering the bag oldest pin first; session-only by design.
topConcern: Gear pins are keyed by bag index, so equipping or selling an earlier piece moves the pin onto a neighbouring piece.

title: The Gear tab's pick, filter, menu and skill-XP tile
oneLine: The Gear tab's picked cell or bag piece, its automatic or sticky filter, the filter menu and the XP tile.
topConcern: A picked bag weapon is held by object identity; a weapon echo drops the card to overview while the bus still reports a pick.

title: The bag's order: recency stamps behind one module clock
oneLine: Recency stamps per inventory key and per stash object that order every bag surface, newest first after pins.
topConcern: Stash stamps key on object identity and the weapon echo replaces the objects, so every equip sends all weapons to the front.

title: The bag's small motions: one ref-counted scheduler and attribute one-shots
oneLine: A ref-counted idle-motion timer and stamped one-shot tile attributes for arrivals, bumps and glints.

title: Equip reveals first: an equip parked until a mystery piece's ceremony lands
oneLine: An Equip press on a '?' piece parked as a run-once callback until the worker's reveal answer and ceremony.
topConcern: An Equip lost to a dead socket stays parked with no expiry and fires on a later plain Reveal, equipping the piece unasked.

title: One-shot item asks from the action list (eat, drink, light, open ticket, claim chest, inspect, cape on/off)
oneLine: Single send-and-close asks from an item's buttons, settled and echoed by the worker.
topConcern: Drink notes the fight's bite before a send that a dead socket drops, so the next bite is refused for nothing.

title: The old full-screen inventory surface and its bus
oneLine: The unmounted legacy inventory surface's open/tab/items/equipped/shortcuts/layers bus and salvage toast.
topConcern: GameApp still subscribes a bridge that writes chest/legs layers from this bus; debug 'inv mock' dresses the character in unearned armour.

title: The expanded Bag page's dormant Equipped tab and the item card's retired layer pickers
oneLine: An equipped-cards tab pinned off and two loadout card kinds with no opener.
topConcern: If revived, the chestLayers toggle skips the level gate and reveal rule; the tab's Unequip takes off the held weapon's slot.

title: The Bag page's category chips (bagFilterBus)
oneLine: A five-value module-scoped filter choice for the expanded Bag page, kept across leaving the page.

title: The Gear tab's XP count-up frame loop and its skill-tile landing points
oneLine: A mount-scoped rAF loop re-rendering while xpLanding counts, and skill tiles registered as XP landing points.
